title: Null patch on required field breaks /get for whole account
description: Servers other than filenode store patched JSON without re-validating. A null (or wrong-typed) patch on a required field with no default (Mailbox name/isSubscribed, Email mailboxIds, EmailSubmission undoStatus, VacationResponse, AddressBook/Calendar/TaskList name/isSubscribed, Principal name/type, chat body/name, CheckItem title, ...) is accepted by /set, then /get of that type returns serverFail for the account. Fix: deserialize the patched JSON into the typed object before storing (as filenode does) and return invalidProperties on failure. Found in JMAP-sofk audit.
close_reason: Fixed in working tree; verified, workspace 3053 passed
